verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents reviewing pull requests in Working Copy: no listing of open PRs, viewing PR diffs, commenting, approving or requesting changes. The app does offer on-device diff viewing, hunk staging and a commit graph, and docs-19 mentions 'creating these' for BitBucket/GitHub/GitLab with an unclear referent. These are adjacent git features or PR creation, not PR review, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can review pull requests from my phone while on the go
